integration.content: Plain strings or explicit DOM Nodes; no HTML string evaluation
integration.data: A scope element or document. Descendants with `data-tooltip` or `title` become triggers. Options: `selector`, `distance` (6 px), `duration` (350 ms).
integration.api: `mount(scope, options)` → `show(anchor, text?)`, `hide(immediate?)`, `update(options)`, `destroy()`. Uses hover and keyboard focus, viewport-aware placement, native top-layer popovers when supported, fade in/out, and reduced-motion support. Hides on pointer leave, click, scrolling, resize, focus loss, Escape or anchor removal. ARIA descriptions and native titles are restored; listeners and timers are removed on destroy. Tooltips are noninteractive descriptions, not menus.
